description.en: Three-ink risograph print, shifted layers and coarse grain.
description.tr: Üç mürekkepli risograf baskı, kaymış katmanlar ve kaba grain.

colorRules.inks: only the three inks on paper; dark tones appear only where inks overprint (multiply), never as a fourth ink
colorRules.inkRed: the highlight: key bar, arrows, the stressed element

display.use: headlines and big numbers, printed in two overprinting inks

inkTexture.type: seeded noise mask that removes small specks of ink

motion.frameRate: inks move on full frames, the paper never moves

enter.type: each ink layer arrives separately and lands a few px off, like a print pass

motion.registrationWobble: misregistration offset changes slightly on accents, seeded

exit.type: slide off as a paper sheet

motion.transition: a new paper sheet slides over the frame, or one ink floods the frame
